The '''Warlord Heavy Cruiser''' was a model of [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] used by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:JtL" />

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Warlord Heavy Cruiser first appeared in the video game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]'', the space part of [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. In the game, the Warlord Heavy Cruiser had similar size and characteristics than those of the [[X4 Gunship/Legends|X4 Gunship]], the [[Ye-4 gunship]], and the [[AEG-77 Vigo]].<ref name="SWG:JtL" />
